info.title: Timezone Converter API Reference
info.description: Convert a timestamp from one timezone to another using timezone names, GPS coordinates, location addresses, IATA/ICAO airport codes, or UN/LOCODEs. Returns the converted time, the original time, and the hour/minute difference between the two timezones. Supports pair-based lookups --- provide source and target using any supported identifier type (e.g., `tz_from` + `tz_to` for IANA names, `lat_from`/`long_from` + `lat_to`/`long_to` for coordinates, `iata_from` + `iata_to` for airport codes). If no `time` parameter is provided the API converts the current time.

get.summary: Convert a timestamp from one timezone to another using any supported location identifier
get.description: Convert a given time from one timezone to another using timezone names, GPS coordinates, location addresses, IATA/ICAO airport codes, or UN/LOCODEs.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Format of the response. Possible values: json, xml.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time to convert in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format. Omit to convert the current time.

parameters.name: tz_from
parameters.description: Source timezone name in IANA format (e.g., Asia/Kolkata) to convert from.

parameters.name: tz_to
parameters.description: Target timezone name in IANA format (e.g., America/New_York) to convert to.

parameters.name: lat_from
parameters.description: Latitude of source location for coordinate-based conversion.

parameters.name: long_from
parameters.description: Longitude of source location for coordinate-based conversion.

parameters.name: lat_to
parameters.description: Latitude of target location for coordinate-based conversion.

parameters.name: long_to
parameters.description: Longitude of target location for coordinate-based conversion.

parameters.name: location_from
parameters.description: Source location address (city and country) for address-based conversion.

parameters.name: location_to
parameters.description: Target location address (city and country) for address-based conversion.

parameters.name: iata_from
parameters.description: Source IATA airport code (3-letter, e.g., JFK) for airport-based conversion.

parameters.name: iata_to
parameters.description: Target IATA airport code (3-letter) for airport-based conversion.

parameters.name: icao_from
parameters.description: Source ICAO airport code (4-letter, e.g., KJFK) for airport-based conversion.

parameters.name: icao_to
parameters.description: Target ICAO airport code (4-letter) for airport-based conversion.

parameters.name: locode_from
parameters.description: Source UN/LOCODE (5-letter) for location code-based conversion.

parameters.name: locode_to
parameters.description: Target UN/LOCODE (5-letter) for location code-based conversion.

fractionalHourOffset.summary: Half-hour timezone offset — diff_hour is not always a whole number (e.g. Asia/Kolkata is UTC+5:30)

400.description: Bad Request — Incomplete parameter combination, invalid timezone name, invalid coordinates, or location address not found

value.message: Parameters' combination is not complete. 'tz_from' and 'tz_to' or 'location_from' and 'location_to' or 'lat_from' and 'long_from' and 'lat_to' and 'long_to' or 'locode_from' and 'locode_to' or 'iata_from' and 'iata_to' or 'icao_from' and 'icao_to' combinations must be provided.
Check whether your input values are correct; source_time_zone = Invalid/TZ, destined_time_zone = Asia/Karachi, date_time = null
Provided  lat_from (999) or long_from (0) is not valid. Latitude must be between -90.0 and +90.0 and longitude must be between -180.0 and +180.0.
We couldn't find the (from) location (ZZZNOTEXIST). Try a city or state level address only.
We couldn't find the (to) location (ZZZNOTEXIST). Try a city or state level address only.

404.description: Not Found — Airport (IATA/ICAO) code or UN/LOCODE has no matching data

value.message: 'Data not found for the provided airport code: XXX Please contact at support@ipgeolocation.io if provided airport code exists.'
'Data not found for the provided LO code: ZZZZZ Please contact at support@ipgeolocation.io if provided LO code exists.'

ApiKeyAuthHeader.name: X-apiKey
ApiKeyAuthHeader.description: Pass your API key via the X-apiKey request header.

ApiKeyAuthQuery.name: apiKey
ApiKeyAuthQuery.description: Pass your API key via the apiKey query parameter.

TimezoneConversionResponse.description: Timezone conversion result containing original and converted timestamps with the difference.

original_time.description: The original date and time before any conversion, in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

converted_time.description: The date and time after conversion to the target timezone, in yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

diff_hour.description: The absolute difference in hours between the source and target timezones, always non-negative regardless of conversion direction. Can be fractional for half-hour/quarter-hour offset timezones (e.g. 9.5 for Asia/Kolkata to America/New_York).

diff_min.description: The absolute difference between the source and target timezones expressed in total minutes (not a remainder — always diff_hour * 60), always non-negative regardless of conversion direction.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned by the API on failed requests.

error.description: Short error category or exception type.

message.description: Human-readable error message describing the failure.

path.description: API endpoint path that produced the error.

status.description: HTTP status code returned with the error.
